dedupe_keys.name: mta subway and rail station envelopes with 50 foot buffer

description: MTA Subway and Rail Station Envelopes with 50 Foot Buffer is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset consists of a set of 2D geospatial polygons that are intended to capture a 50-foot buffer around all publicly accessible areas of NYCT, LIRR, and MNR rail mass transit stations within the City of New York as defined by the New York City Zoning Resolution Article 6 Chapter 6 – Special Regulations Applying ... Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are subway stations, staten island railway, sir, metro-north, metro-north railroad. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
